units.source_text: 为了朱雀院行幸的事，贵公子们都兴致勃勃，天天聚集在一起。

en.t: Because of the upcoming imperial visit to Suzaku-in, the young noblemen were all in high spirits and gathered together every day.

units.source_text: 舞蹈和奏乐的预习，成了他们每日的作业。

en.t: Practicing the dances and the music became their daily task.

units.source_text: 乐器的声音，比往日嘈杂得多。

en.t: The sound of the instruments was far noisier than usual.

units.source_text: 贵公子们互相竞争，也比往日更加起劲。

en.t: The young noblemen competed with one another and threw themselves into it with even more enthusiasm than usual.

units.source_text: 他们吹奏声音响亮的大筚篥和尺八箫[\[5\]](#part1335.html#m5)。

en.t: They played loud-toned large hichiriki pipes and shakuhachi flutes[\[5\]](#part1335.html#m5).

units.source_text: 鼓本来是放在下面的，现在也搬进栏杆里来，由贵公子们亲自演奏。

en.t: The drums, which had originally been placed below, were now brought inside the railing as well, and the young noblemen played them themselves.

units.source_text: 因此源氏公子也很忙碌。

en.t: Because of this, Lord Genji was also very busy.

units.source_text: 几个关切的恋人家里，他也偷闲去访，但常陆亲王家这位小姐那里，他一直不去。

en.t: He found spare moments to visit the homes of several lovers he cared about, but he never went to see the young lady at Prince Hitachi's house.
The season had already reached late autumn.

units.source_text: 小姐家里只是佳音杳杳，光阴空过。

en.t: At the young lady's house there was still no welcome word from him, and the days passed by in vain.
